en.t: A wire-haired little hunting dog, of course.

units.source_text: 原产英国的硬毛小猎狗。

en.t: A wire-haired little hunting dog originally from England.

units.source_text: 据说这种狗在欧洲和美国很流行，甚至不牵着硬毛小猎狗就不算是贵妇人。

en.t: They say this kind of dog is very fashionable in Europe and America, and that a lady is not even considered a proper gentlewoman unless she has a wire-haired little hunting dog on a leash.

units.source_text: 听说要给它理发，每次给它喂食的时候，都要把它嘴边的毛揩拭干净呢。”

en.t: I hear you have to have its hair trimmed, and every time you feed it, you have to wipe the fur around its mouth clean.
